settlement_source: ATTYGEN.pdf names the state (New York) as Source Agency; API lists generic kalshi.com. In practice accelerated resolution uses 4/8 media decision-desk calls.
settlement_variable: Party of person sworn in as New York Attorney General pursuant to the 2026 election (term beginning 2027). Party switch between election and swearing-in: party on election day counts. Independent is specified by name.
trading_close_vs_settlement: Last Trading Time = Expiration time (10:00 AM ET). Latest expiration = 1 year after scheduled election; moved earlier when a new AG is sworn in (Rule 7.2). Settlement no later than day after expiry unless under review (Rule 7.1). Accelerated resolution on >=4/8 Designated Media Sources; API close_time 2027-11-03 nominal, can_close_early=1, settlement_timer_seconds=1800 (vs 14s for GOVPARTY).
early_close_or_void_clauses: Accelerated determination by 4/8 media consensus (NYT, AP, DDHQ, CNN, Fox, NBC, CBS, ABC; formal projection or unambiguous article statement; affiliates fold into parent; national desk supersedes). Exchange may replace a source at sole discretion. Kalshi may start Market Outcome Review (Rule 7.1) at sole discretion; if Expiration Value cannot be determined Kalshi decides payouts per Rule 7.1. Revisions after Expiration ignored. No explicit vacancy-before-seating clause (GOVPARTY has one).
title_vs_rules_divergences: Title 'win the Attorney General race' vs rules: payout is on person SWORN IN for the 2027 term, not election winner/certification.
Accelerated path settles on media projections, not certification.
